title: CPSC, SMC and Home Depot Announce Recall of Oscillating Fans
summary: The electric power cord can be damaged by the oscillation motion of the fan. The damage to the cord can result in a short circuit and possible ignition of the plastic case, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2.2 million.

title: CPSC, Far East Brokers and Consultants Inc. Announce Recall of Kiddie Car Cruisers Sold Exclusively at Big Y Stores
summary: The Kiddie Car Cruiser can continue to run when the accelerator is no longer depressed, which could result in the rider losing control of the car. Units: About 500.

title: CPSC, First Samco Inc. Announce Recall to Replace Gun Holsters
summary: A plastic or leather strap on the gun holster can catch the trigger of the gun when inserted into the holster, causing the gun to unintentionally discharge, posing an injury hazard to the user. Units: About 3,200.

title: CPSC, Dynamic Cooking Systems Announce Recall of Self-Cleaning Wall Ovens
summary: When the oven is in the self-cleaning mode, the oven's exterior door temperature exceeds the allowable surface temperature limits under the industry voluntary standard for household electric ranges. Sustained contact with the door during self-cleaning mode could cause burns. Units: About 1,400.

title: CPSC, Old Navy Announce Recall of Children's Zippered Outerwear
summary: The plastic zipper pull can detach from the zipper, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 666,000.

title: CPSC, Targus Announce Recall of International Plug Adapters
summary: The adapters may have an electrical wiring problem, posing a shock and fire hazard to consumers. Units: 34,000.

title: CPSC, Sportcraft Announce Recall of Tredex Treadmills
summary: The treadmill's circuitry can overheat, causing it to unexpectedly accelerate during use. When this happens, the user can fall. Units: 320.

title: CPSC, Electrolux Home Products Announce Recall of Air Conditioning/Heating Units
summary: The heating coil in the units can be damaged during assembly, causing an electrical short and overheating, which poses a fire hazard to consumers. Units: 5,800.

title: CPSC, Marukyo USA Announce Recall of Hair Dryers
summary: These electric hair dryers are not equipped with an immersion protection device, to prevent electrocution, if the hair dryer falls into water. Units: 6,100.

title: CPSC, Dream On Me Industries Announce Recall of Baby Walkers
summary: The walkers will fit through a standard doorway and are not designed to stop at the edge of a step. Babies using these walkers can be seriously injured or killed if they fall down stairs. Units: About 20,000.

title: CPSC, Payless ShoeSource Announce Recall of Children's Athletic Shoes
summary: The metal eyelet lace holder at the top of the shoe can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 441,000.

title: CPSC, American Promotional Events Inc. Announce Recall of Fireworks
summary: These fireworks could have a defective fuse that can fail to ignite the device. Consumers who attempt to re-light the fuse could suffer serious injury. CPSC advises consumers never to re-light any fireworks that do not ignite after the first attempt. Units: About 11,700 units.

title: CPSC, Verizon Wireless Announce Recall of Counterfeit Cell Phone Batteries
summary: Some LG-branded TM-510 batteries may be counterfeit and susceptible to overcharging, especially if used with a non-LG charger. LG Infocomm U.S.A. title: CPSC, Ames True Temper Re-Announce Recall of Wheelbarrows - Company Offering Gardening Tool Gift to Consumers with Repair
summary: The plastic wheel assemblies on these wheelbarrows can break when the tires are being inflated. This can result in plastic pieces exploding from the rims of the wheels, possibly hitting nearby consumers and causing lacerations and other injuries. Units: About 647,000.

title: CPSC, Dorel Juvenile Group USA Announce Recall to Inspect and Replace COSCO® "Rock 'N Roller" Baby Strollers
summary: If the stop pins are bent or missing or the seat is not fully attached, the seat can partially detach from the frame during use and the infant occupant can be injured in a fall. Units: 300,000.

title: CPSC, Kmart Corp. Announce Recall of Girls' Rompers
summary: The crocheted cherry-shape tassels and plastic buttons may pull off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 20,000.

title: CPSC, Lakeshore Learning Materials Announce Recall of Doll Sets
summary: The head and boot of the dolls can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 2,800.

title: CPSC, Samara Brothers Inc. Announce Recall of Children's Swimsuit Cover-ups
summary: The zipper-pull on the cover-up can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: 30,000.

title: CPSC, GapKids Announce Recall of Girls' Straw Cowboy Hats
summary: The straw hat is constructed using a thin wire within a seam. The tip of the wire can break free from the seam, posing a laceration hazard. Units: 5,200.

title: CPSC, Carrier Commercial Refrigeration, Inc. Announce Recall of Grocery Frozen Food Case Heaters
summary: Moisture building up pressure inside the defrost heater can cause it to forcefully eject from the frozen food case, possibly injuring bystanders. Units: 16,000.

title: CPSC, Huffy Bicycle Company Announce Recall of "Cranbrook" Bicycles Sold at Wal-Mart
summary: The handlebar could unexpectedly loosen, causing the rider to lose control of bicycle. Units: 12,000.

title: CPSC, Linn Inc. Announce Recall of Power Amplifiers for Sound Systems
summary: The amplifier's capacitors can overheat, blow a fuse, and damage the products to which they are connected, presenting a fire hazard. Units: About 2,157 units.

title: CPSC, Associated Electrics Inc. Announce Recall of Battery Chargers for Radio Control Race Cars
summary: A defective fuse and program error in the charger can cause the battery packs being charged to overheat and explode, posing a risk of serious injury to consumers. Units: 4,900.

title: CPSC, Basler Electric Co. and Lutron Electronics Announce Recall of Power Supply Units
summary: The power supply, if overloaded, can overheat, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: 3,000.

title: CPSC, The Land of Nod® Announce Recall of Children's Wooden Chairs
summary: The leg supports can crack, causing the chair to collapse. Children sitting in these chairs can fall. Units: 3,500.

title: CPSC, Wal-Mart Stores, Inc. Announce Recall of Slow Cookers
summary: The heating element can drop to the bottom of the slow cooker and melt through the plastic outer shell, posing a burn hazard to users. Units: 146,000.

title: CPSC, Allen Organ Company Announce Recall of Wooden Organ Bench
summary: The wooden bench may collapse because not enough glue was used during assembly. Units: 1,757.

title: CPSC, Echo Inc. Announce Recall of Gas-Powered Hand Tools
summary: The fuel lines on these tools can develop an "alligator surface" appearance, which could develop into a condition that will allow leakage of gasoline and fuel vapor, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 540,000.
